'''Bind''' is a level 20 [[Magic]] [[Spells|spell]] located in the [[Standard spellbook]]. Casting bind on an opponent will prevent it from moving for 8 [[ticks]]  (4.8 seconds). When used on a player and the bind is about to wear off, the bound player will receive this message in their chatbox: {{mes|The holding effect is beginning to fade.|color=red}} Players can increase the binding duration by equipping [[swampbark armour]]; the [[Swampbark helm|helm]], [[Swampbark body|body]], and [[Swampbark legs|legs]] will increase the duration by 2 [[ticks]] (1.2 seconds) each, up to a maximum of 14 [[ticks]] (8.4 seconds).

Bind gives 31 Magic [[experience]] if it successfully hits the target, or 30 experience if it [[splash]]es. It requires two [[Nature rune|nature]], three [[Earth rune|earth]], and three [[water rune]]s to be cast.
